messages:
alex: Heads-up — kicking off a prod deploy for routing-v2 in ~15m (ETA ~2026-03-17T20:30Z). Requesting a quickscan and rollback-readout before we promote. @maria @sam please confirm readiness. :rocket:

maria: on it, alex. I'll run the canary queries + smoke checklist. ping me when canary hits 5%. :white_check_mark:

sam: infra side ready. Node pools stable, autoscaler policy unchanged. I'll watch the GPU queue and scheduler latency. Rule of thumb: if p95 inference latency > 250ms for 5m, we consider rollback. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex for routing-v2. Canary target: 5% traffic. Job ID: deploy-2165004321. See: https://deploys.redwood.internal/jobs/deploy-2165004321

linh: Quickscan checklist I'll run once canary is up: 1) health endpoints 2) basic generate smoke 3) KV cache sanity 4) tail logs for errors. Command I use:
```bash
curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://prod.redwood.api/health | jq .
```
Posting results in ~5m.

natalie: I'll watch observability — latency, error-rate, token cost. Prometheus queries I'll keep on hand (p95, error rate, request volume). Will call out any alert-ish behavior. :stethoscope:

alex: Rollback plan (manual-first): 1) flip feature flag `routing_v2_enabled=false` 2) redeploy canary image `routing:stable-v1` via pipeline 3) notify customers if >30m. Keep manual approvals open.

maria: Canary warm + initial smoke pass. Key checks: POST /v1/generate p95 120ms, error-rate ~0.01% over last 2m. No new WARNs in logs. :thumbsup:

sam: infra metrics look good. No backlog on request queue and pod CPU stable.

linh: health curl output: `{"status":"ok","models":["routing-v1","routing-v2"]}`. Ran 200 generate requests — no KV misses, responses within expected latency range.

natalie: Dashboards stable. p50 +3ms, p95 unchanged. No alerts fired. Ready for rollout to 100% unless someone objects.

alex: Rolling to 100% now. If anyone sees regressions, call rollback immediately. We'll keep a 30m quiet window then close thread. :white_check_mark:

maria: noted — standing by to run targeted QA if anything odd appears.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete — routing-v2 rolled to 100%. Job deploy-2165004321 succeeded. Summary: canary->100% took 9m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/jobs/deploy-2165004321/logs

sam: Nice. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to tweak autoscaler thresholds (micro-adjust).

alex: Thanks team — nice quick run. Closing after the 30m quiet window unless anyone flags an issue. :beers:
